basics.name: Mahmoud Bekheet
basics.label: Senior Front-end Developer

work.name: Cura Healthcare

Architected and maintained a Next.js and TypeScript platform supporting 3,000+ monthly consultations, improving measured web-performance metrics by approximately 30% through rendering, asset, and loading optimizations.
Built a real-time patient-doctor chat system using React and REST API integrations, improving communication continuity during online consultations and reducing consultation drop-off.

Reduced average data-loading time by approximately 35% through caching, lazy loading, and request optimization in Next.js; also led delivery of payment gateways, authentication flows, SEO enhancements, and user-tracking integrations.
Designed reusable frontend patterns for authentication, API integration, state management, and cross-platform functionality.
